credential_capture.label: Optional H-E-B sign-in details
credential_capture.description: You can save both details for automated sign-in and session repair, or leave both blank to sign in in the secure browser. Credentials are stored only for this connection.
credential_capture.submit_label: Save optional details and start collection

refresh_policy.rationale: H-E-B is fronted by Imperva Incapsula and supports passkeys plus verification codes, so first login is owner-present; the session then persists in the browser profile and scheduled refresh reuses it. Parsers are verified against real logged-in heb.com DOM (order list + order detail). assisted_after_owner_auth:true means a background run may ask the owner for bounded help when a bot challenge appears.

streams.name: orders
streams.description: H-E-B curbside/delivery orders scraped from Your Orders. Preferred source is the order-list page's embedded structured data when present and trustworthy; the rendered-DOM parser is a fail-safe fallback for a page or row where structured data is absent, malformed, or untrustworthy. In-store purchases are not available from heb.com and do not appear here.

display.label: Your H-E-B orders
display.detail: Order date, total, fulfillment method (curbside/delivery), fulfillment location, status, item count, and (when the structured source supplies them) status code, timeslot, store name, and unfulfilled-item count. Curbside/delivery orders only; in-store purchases are not available from heb.com. Per-item breakdowns live in the order_items stream.

status_code.description: Machine-readable order status code from the structured order-list source (e.g. "PAYMENT_RECEIPTED"), distinct from the human-readable `status` message. An honest bounded/open string reflecting values actually observed in structured source evidence, not a closed enum inferred from one account's order history. Null when the structured source did not supply this row.

store_name.description: Fulfilling store name from the structured order-list source. Null when the structured source did not supply this row.

timeslot_start.description: Delivery/pickup timeslot start (ISO-8601 UTC) from the structured order-list source. Null when the structured source did not supply this row.

timeslot_end.description: Delivery/pickup timeslot end (ISO-8601 UTC) from the structured order-list source. Null when the structured source did not supply this row.

unfulfilled_count.description: Count of purchase-line items the source reports as unfulfilled on this order, from the structured order-list source's orderChangesOverview.unfulfilledCount. Distinct from item_count (the order's total item count). Null when the structured source did not supply this row.

views.label: Fields for matching to bank/YNAB transactions

streams.name: order_items
streams.description: Line items within H-E-B orders. Curbside/delivery orders only; in-store purchases are not available from heb.com. product_id is the H-E-B provider/catalog identifier observed on the order-detail purchase line, not a global product identity (GTIN/UPC/EAN); no such field is collected because no live-evidenced H-E-B response has been shown to carry one on the purchase line, and this connector does not crawl product pages to obtain one.

display.label: Your H-E-B order line items
display.detail: Product name, department, H-E-B product id, product URL, image, quantity, line total, denormalized order date.

streams.name: profile
streams.description: H-E-B account profile for this connection, scraped from My Account. Mirrors the wholefoods.profile shape (name, email) per the cutover capability map's lead_decision for heb.profile, extended with phone and delivery_addresses to close the legacy heb.profile parity gap.

display.label: Your H-E-B profile
display.detail: Name, email, phone, and delivery addresses on file for your H-E-B account.

phone.description: Legacy heb.profile parity field, ported from legacy connectors/heb/heb-playwright.js scrapeProfile().

delivery_addresses.description: Legacy heb.profile parity field (deliveryAddresses[]), ported from legacy connectors/heb/heb-playwright.js scrapeProfile(). Not a child stream: an address has no identity beyond the parent profile record (D3).

streams.name: nutrition
streams.description: Nutrition facts and lookup outcomes per unique H-E-B product ordered. Product URLs are retained from order-item source evidence; Incapsula blocks emit source=blocked with no nutrition values and a session-repair diagnostic. Common nutrient field names (calories, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, sodium_mg, fiber_g, sugar_g, serving_size, servings_per_container) share the wholefoods.nutrition contract shape per the cutover capability map's lead_decision for heb.nutrition; H-E-B's extra legacy fields (vitamins, minerals, upc, ingredients, allergens, category, highlights) are additional optional fields.

display.label: Your H-E-B product nutrition
display.detail: Calories, macros, vitamins/minerals, serving size, ingredients, and allergens for products in your orders.

product_url.description: Product page URL observed on the H-E-B order item; never constructed or inferred.

saturated_fat_g.description: H-E-B-specific additional field, not in the shared wholefoods.nutrition contract.

reason_display_messages.empty_page_before_max_page: We hit an empty page of orders before we expected to, so we stopped to check rather than assume we were done
reason_display_messages.heb_empty_history_after_prior_orders: H-E-B reported no order history, but we previously collected orders for this account. Your stored orders are retained and untouched. We stopped this run instead of recording an empty history, because a page showing no orders can't prove your history is gone
reason_display_messages.item_count_short: Some orders hold fewer items than H-E-B says they contain
reason_display_messages.list_page_navigation_failed: We couldn't load a page of your H-E-B order history and didn't want to assume that meant the end
reason_display_messages.list_page_shape_check_failed: The page didn't look like we expected
reason_display_messages.nutrition_navigation_failed: We couldn't load a product page to read its nutrition facts
reason_display_messages.nutrition_source_coverage_incomplete: We did not mark H-E-B nutrition complete because the order history or order-item detail coverage is incomplete
reason_display_messages.older_pages_deferred_page_budget: We stopped after reading the most recent pages of your order history, so older orders haven't been collected yet. Nothing was lost — the next run picks up where this one stopped
reason_display_messages.pagination_exhausted: We reached the end of the available pages
reason_display_messages.pagination_metadata_absent: H-E-B didn't tell us how many pages of orders there are, so we stopped to avoid missing any
reason_display_messages.pagination_metadata_contradictory: H-E-B gave us conflicting page-count information, so we stopped to avoid missing any orders
reason_display_messages.profile_navigation_failed: We couldn't load your H-E-B account profile page
reason_display_messages.profile_shape_check_failed: Your H-E-B account profile page didn't look like we expected
reason_display_messages.scope_not_supported: This can't be collected with the streams you selected
reason_display_messages.selector_drift: The page layout changed and we couldn't find what we needed
reason_display_messages.session_repair_required: We need you to sign in or pass a verification check to continue
reason_display_messages.source_auth_or_challenge: We need you to sign in or pass a verification check to continue
reason_display_messages.source_reported_empty: H-E-B showed us your order history and it has no orders in it
reason_display_messages.source_reported_empty_after_retention: H-E-B no longer lists your orders because they're older than its retention window. Your collected orders are retained and untouched, and new orders will be collected normally
reason_display_messages.unparseable_order_date: We skipped some orders because their dates couldn't be read
